features.name: Selective Door Unlocking (Single Door)
features.description: First press of remote key fob unlocks driver door only; second press unlocks all doors.

features.name: Speed-Dependent Auto Locking (>15 km/h)
features.description: Automatically locks all passenger and cargo doors when vehicle speed exceeds 15 km/h (anti-carjacking).

features.name: Auto-Unlock on Key Removal
features.description: Automatically unlocks all doors when the mechanical ignition key is withdrawn from the barrel.

features.name: Central Locking Remote Control Active
features.description: Enables wireless RF receiver processing for factory remote key fobs.

features.name: Acoustic Lock Confirmation
features.description: Sounds brief alarm siren chirp when all vehicle doors and tailgate are securely locked.

features.name: Optical Confirmation on Locking
features.description: Flashes hazard/turn indicators once upon successful vehicle locking.

features.name: Optical Confirmation on Unlocking
features.description: Flashes hazard/turn indicators twice upon remote unlocking.

features.name: Anti-Theft Alarm Siren Installed
features.description: Enables LIN-bus communication with the internal battery-backed alarm sounder (H12).

features.name: Comfort Window Operation via Remote Key
features.description: Allows opening and closing electric power windows by holding the remote key fob buttons.

features.name: Front Windscreen Teardrop Wipe
features.description: Performs one delayed wipe across the front windscreen 5 seconds after washing to clear fluid runoff.

features.name: Rear Window Wiper Installed
features.description: Enables power feed and stalk control for tailgate rear wiper motor.

features.name: Heated Mirrors Synced with Rear Defogger
features.description: Automatically activates exterior heated door mirrors when the rear window defogger switch is engaged.

features.name: Rain-Closing Windows
features.description: Automatically winds up open windows if rain is sensed while vehicle is locked and parked.

features.name: Daytime Running Lights (DRL) Active
features.description: Master switch enabling dedicated daytime running lamps when ignition is switched ON.

features.name: DRL Toggle in Cluster Display (MFA)
features.description: Adds Daytime Running Lights ON/OFF checkbox to the Instrument Cluster multifunction display menu.
features.prerequisites: Higher-specification instrument cluster with multifunction display.

features.name: Headlight Washer System Installed (SRA)
features.description: Enables high-pressure bumper headlight washer pump activation every 5 windscreen wash cycles.
features.prerequisites: Headlight washer pump and bumper jets.

features.name: Leaving Home Illumination
features.description: Illuminates headlights/sidelights when vehicle is unlocked via remote key in the dark.
features.prerequisites: Rain/Light sensor with Auto headlight switch.

features.name: Coming Home Illumination
features.description: Maintains exterior lighting after ignition is switched off to guide occupant to house.

features.name: DRL via Dipped Beam Headlights
features.description: Operates dipped low beam headlights as Daytime Running Lights (Scandinavian mode).

features.name: DRL via Front Fog Lights (North America)
features.description: Illuminates front fog lamps as daytime running lights instead of main headlights.

features.name: Dynamic Cornering Fog Lights
features.description: Illuminates the front fog lamp on the steered or indicated side during low-speed maneuvers (below 40 km/h).
features.prerequisites: Front fog lamps must be physically installed and wired.

features.name: Coming Home (Stalk Triggered)
features.description: Activates Coming Home lighting for 30 seconds upon pulling high-beam flash stalk after ignition OFF.

features.name: Single-Side Parking Lights
features.description: Illuminates side lights on the chosen side when turn indicator stalk is left up/down with ignition off.

features.name: Deactivate DRL with Parking Brake
features.description: Shuts off daytime running lamps whenever the mechanical handbrake lever is engaged.

features.name: Rear Wiper on Reverse Gear
features.description: Automatically sweeps rear window wiper once when reverse gear is engaged with front wipers active.
features.prerequisites: Rear wiper must be physically equipped.

features.name: Emergency Brake Hazard Flashing
features.description: Automatically pulses hazard warning flashers rapidly during severe deceleration or ABS intervention.

features.name: Emergency Brake Light Flashing
features.description: Rapidly flashes rear brake lights under heavy threshold braking.

features.name: Highway Comfort Turn Signals
features.description: Flashing cycle pulses 3 times when the turn indicator stalk is lightly tapped.

features.name: Front Fog Lights Installed
features.description: Registers physical front fog lamp wiring and light switch front fog position.

features.name: Footwell Interior Lighting Installed
features.description: Enables ambient driver and passenger footwell lighting circuits upon door opening.
